aboutMe.heading: About me
description: I'm a full-stack product engineer who builds fast, scalable systems using TypeScript, React, Node, and cloud services. I leverage AI tools to accelerate development and ship faster without sacrificing quality. I'm obsessed with solving problems that matter and getting to market quickly. Whether it's designing solid backend architecture, optimizing performance, or managing production systems, I focus on what drives real impact. I love building products that feel great and help people get things done.
